title: 🗺️ Google Maps Lead Scraper
description: Search Google Maps and export lead-ready business data. Provide either searchQueries with location, a customGeolocation, direct placeIds, or direct placeUrls.

searchQueries.title: 🔎 Search queries
searchQueries.description: One Google Maps search term per item, for example dentist or dental clinic.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Choose what to search for and where the Actor should search.

searchQueriesText.title: 📝 Bulk search queries text
searchQueriesText.description: Optional newline- or comma-separated search queries. The Actor normalizes this into searchQueries before the crawl starts.

location.title: 📍 Where should we search?
location.description: Enter a city, region, or country. Example: Berlin, Germany. This stays a standard Google Maps text search unless you also provide geolocation fields or a custom geolocation.

geolocation.title: 🧭 Geolocation parameters
geolocation.description: Optional OpenStreetMap/Nominatim fields for more precise matching than free-text location alone.

country.title: 🌍 Country
country.description: Optional country name for OpenStreetMap matching, for example Germany or United States.

postalCode.title: 🏷️ Postal code
postalCode.description: Optional ZIP or postal code for more precise matching.

expandAreaWhenResultsLow.title: 🗺️ Expand area when results are low
expandAreaWhenResultsLow.description: Keep the normal text search first, then explore nearby map areas only if the first search page returns a sparse result set.

customGeolocation.title: 📐 Custom geolocation
customGeolocation.description: Optional geometry override for direct point or polygon targeting.

type.title: 🔷 Geometry type
type.description: GeoJSON geometry type to use for the custom geolocation.

coordinates.title: 📍 Coordinates
coordinates.description: GeoJSON-style coordinates. Use coordinatesJson when editing raw JSON is easier.

radiusKm.title: 📏 Radius in km
radiusKm.description: Radius around the point when type is Point.

latitude.title: ↕️ Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude used when passing a point as latitude and longitude instead of coordinates.

longitude.title: ↔️ Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude used when passing a point as latitude and longitude instead of coordinates.

coordinatesJson.title: 🧾 Coordinates JSON
coordinatesJson.description: Raw JSON string for GeoJSON coordinates.

categories.title: ✅ Included categories
categories.description: Optional include filter for Google Maps business categories.
categories.sectionDescription: Keep the output focused on the business types you want.

excludedCategories.title: 🚫 Excluded categories
excludedCategories.description: Optional exclude filter for categories you do not want in the final dataset.

businessStatus.title: 🏢 Business status
businessStatus.description: Filter by open or closed status when Google Maps exposes it.

targetCategory.title: 📈 Target category
targetCategory.description: Optional category hint used to boost opportunity scoring.

maxPlaces.title: 📦 Maximum dataset items
maxPlaces.description: Stop when this many valid places have been pushed to the dataset.

maxProfiles.title: 👤 Maximum profiles to open
maxProfiles.description: Hard cap for successfully opened Google Maps profile pages in deep mode.

maxEnrichments.title: 💳 Maximum enrichments
maxEnrichments.description: Hard cap for website contact-enrichment attempts in deep mode.

maxResults.title: 🛑 Maximum processed results
maxResults.description: Optional secondary cap. If both maxPlaces and maxResults are set, the lower limit wins.

maxRunTimeSec.title: ⏰ Maximum runtime in seconds
maxRunTimeSec.description: Stop the run once this runtime budget is exceeded to prevent excessive cost.

maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.title: 🔢 Maximum crawled places per search
maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.description: Optional cap per search query before filtering and post-processing.

mode.title: 🏎️ Execution mode
mode.description: Fast mode is list-only and cheapest. Deep mode allows profile opening and enrichment with strict caps.
mode.sectionDescription: Use these caps to keep cost bounded and align premium work with premium pricing.

openProfiles.title: 🔓 Open profiles
openProfiles.description: Allow profile-page opening in deep mode. Forced off in fast mode.

enableEnrichment.title: 🧪 Enable enrichment
enableEnrichment.description: Allow website contact enrichment in deep mode. Forced off in fast mode.

leadMode.title: ✨ Lead mode
leadMode.description: Legacy convenience toggle that switches the Actor into deep mode with profiles and enrichment enabled.
leadMode.sectionDescription: Turn on richer place data, website contact discovery, and lead scoring.

includePlaceDetails.title: 🗂️ Include place details
includePlaceDetails.description: Legacy compatibility flag. In production flows, prefer openProfiles plus mode.

includeContacts.title: 📬 Include contacts
includeContacts.description: Visit each business website and extract public contact details.

includeEnrichment.title: 🧠 Include lead enrichment
includeEnrichment.description: Add lead-prioritization fields for downstream sales workflows.

generateIcebreakers.title: 💬 Generate icebreakers
generateIcebreakers.description: Reserved AI-friendly toggle for downstream workflows.

includeReviews.title: 📝 Include reviews
includeReviews.description: Collect Google reviews for deeper research.

includeImages.title: 🖼️ Include images
includeImages.description: Collect place image metadata when available.

includeReviewerNames.title: 🙍 Include reviewer names
includeReviewerNames.description: When false, review outputs omit reviewer names.

minimalLogging.title: 🤫 Minimal logging
minimalLogging.description: Reduce place titles, full addresses, and full URLs in logs.

useProxy.title: 🛡️ Use Apify Proxy
useProxy.description: Recommended for better reliability on Google Maps.
useProxy.sectionDescription: Tune reliability, throughput, and timeouts for local and cloud runs.

maxConcurrency.title: ⚡ Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Overall browser concurrency for the crawl.

detailsConcurrency.title: 🧵 Details concurrency override
detailsConcurrency.description: Optional separate concurrency for detail-page work when enableDetailsConcurrencyOverride is true.

enableDetailsConcurrencyOverride.title: 🎚️ Enable details concurrency override
enableDetailsConcurrencyOverride.description: Use detailsConcurrency instead of maxConcurrency for detail pages.

contactEnrichmentConcurrency.title: 🌐 Contact enrichment concurrency
contactEnrichmentConcurrency.description: Optional separate concurrency for website contact enrichment.

navigationTimeout.title: ⏳ Navigation timeout in seconds
navigationTimeout.description: Increase if Google Maps or target websites are slow.

runMode.title: 💾 Run mode
runMode.description: Use fresh for a baseline and incremental for new or changed businesses only.

detectUpdates.title: 🔁 Detect updates
detectUpdates.description: When incremental mode is enabled, compare current results with saved state.

stateKey.title: 🗃️ State key
stateKey.description: Key-value store record used for incremental state.

resetState.title: ♻️ Reset saved state
resetState.description: Delete the saved incremental snapshot before the run starts.

dedupeStrategy.title: 🧩 Dedupe strategy
dedupeStrategy.description: Choose how recurring runs identify the same business.

updateFields.title: 📋 Tracked update fields
updateFields.description: Fields compared between runs to detect updates.

enableCaching.title: 🚀 Enable caching
enableCaching.description: Reuse cached place enrichments across runs.

incrementalUpdate.title: 🔄 Incremental cache updates
incrementalUpdate.description: Refresh cached entries as new data arrives.

streamResults.title: 📡 Stream results
streamResults.description: Enable result streaming hooks during the run.

redisUrl.title: 🔗 Redis URL
redisUrl.description: Optional Redis connection string for persistent cache storage.

placeIds.title: 🆔 Direct place IDs
placeIds.description: Optional Google Maps place IDs for direct detail scraping.
placeIds.sectionDescription: Use one of these instead of a search query when you already know the places you want.

placeUrls.title: 🔗 Direct place URLs
placeUrls.description: Optional Google Maps place URLs for direct detail scraping.

exportFormat.title: 📤 Export format hint
exportFormat.description: Optional downstream export preference used by local helpers.

compressOutput.title: 🗜️ Compress output
compressOutput.description: Optional downstream export flag for local helpers.

saveSearchResults.title: 💽 Save search-results dataset
saveSearchResults.description: Save list-view places to the search-results dataset for later direct-detail runs.

n8nEvent.title: 🔔 n8n event payload
n8nEvent.description: Optional raw n8n workflow event input.

n8nFieldMapping.title: 🧭 n8n field mapping
n8nFieldMapping.description: Optional mapping from incoming n8n fields to canonical Actor input fields.

n8nPromptMaxBytes.title: 📏 n8n prompt max bytes
n8nPromptMaxBytes.description: Maximum bytes copied into the synthesized n8n prompt field.

n8nLateEventThresholdSeconds.title: ⏰ n8n late-event threshold seconds
n8nLateEventThresholdSeconds.description: Treat events older than this threshold as late.

n8nPromptField.title: 📝 n8n prompt field
n8nPromptField.description: Destination field name for the synthesized n8n prompt.

openClaw.title: 🦞 OpenClaw integration
openClaw.description: Optional gateway integration for forwarding scraped places.

enabled.title: ✅ Enabled
enabled.description: Forward scraped places to the OpenClaw gateway.

gatewayUrl.title: 🌉 Gateway URL
gatewayUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenClaw gateway.

token.title: 🔐 Gateway token
token.description: Optional OpenClaw token. Prefer environment variables or Apify secrets for production runs.

agentId.title: 🤖 Agent ID
agentId.description: Agent identifier used by the gateway.

concurrency.title: ⚡ Concurrency
concurrency.description: Maximum number of in-flight gateway requests.

sendMode.title: 📨 Send mode
sendMode.description: Send each place immediately or in batches.

batchSize.title: 📦 Batch size
batchSize.description: Batch size when sendMode is batch.

api.title: 🧪 API
api.description: OpenAI-compatible API surface exposed by the gateway.
